Why Choose Us?

Our Expertise

We specialize in Next.js development, high-performance SEO, and 'Rank and Rent' digital real estate strategies.

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 16, 2026

At OfficialUM1, we prioritize your privacy. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your data.

1. Information We Collect

  • Account Data: When you register, we collect your email address and password (encrypted).
  • Guest Checkout: If you checkout as a guest, we store your email address solely for order delivery and linking to future accounts.
  • Payment Data: We do not store your credit card details. All payments are processed securely by Stripe, Cryptomus, or Binance Pay.

2. How We Use Your Data

  • To process and deliver your orders.
  • To communicate order updates via Email or Telegram (if provided).
  • To provide customer support and resolve disputes.

3. Data Protection

We use industry-standard encryption (SSL) to protect your data during transmission. Your passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text.

4. Cookies

We use essential cookies to maintain your login session and shopping cart. We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to request the deletion of your account and data at any time by contacting support. Note that order records may be retained for legal/accounting purposes.

6. Contact Us

For privacy concerns, contact us at hello@officialum1.com.
